episode.title: Ep. 142: The Last Search Engine — Signal Drift

sections.name: player
sections.headline: Signal Drift · Episode 142
sections.subheadline: The Last Search Engine — with guest Aanya Krishnan, 47:22, released November 14, 2024.

sections.name: description
sections.description: Three-paragraph episode summary about the decline of general-purpose web search and the rise of niche indexes, including a pull-quote from the conversation.

sections.name: chapters
sections.description: Time-stamped chapter markers in mono type: '00:00 Cold open', '03:14 The Google problem', '17:40 Marginalia and Kagi', '34:02 What comes after the index', '44:50 Listener mail'.

sections.name: guest_bio
sections.description: Host photo and bio for Maya Okafor plus guest card for Aanya Krishnan, search engineer formerly at DuckDuckGo, with two-sentence bio and links.

sections.name: links_mentioned
sections.description: Bulleted list of references cited in the episode: Marginalia Search, the 1998 PageRank paper, and a New Yorker essay by Anna Wiener.

sections.description: Link to full machine-edited transcript (serif type) with note that transcripts are produced within 48 hours of release.
